item.title: Bill requiring aircraft locator systems that NTSB recommends to prevent midair collisions fails
item.description: Attendees hold up signs reading “Complete the NTSB Safety Reforms Without Delay” and “This Was Preventable. ADSB-IN was NTSB Recommended in 2004” during a Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee hearing in Washington, DC, US, on Thursday, Feb. 12, 2026. NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy is expected to discuss her agency’s findings and recommendations on the January 2025 midair collision near Washington that killed 67 people. Photographer: Stefani Reynolds/Bloomberg via Getty Images
